entry.name: mc.snowphasor~
entry.description: The mc.snowphasor~ object generates phasor ramps in multiple audio channels according to global controls such as an average rate. The object can also trigger ramps from a multi-channel audio signal.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.digest: Interval
attributes.description: When theattribute is set to(0),sets the time between updates of the population density of output phasors per unit time. New phasors will be started only during one of these updates.When theattribute is set to(1),sets time between updates of the average rate per unit time of phasors. New phasors will only be started during one of these updates. Even if theis effectively faster than the, phasors will not be generated closer together in time than thespecifies. When thewould generate multiple phasors in the time of anthey are started simultaneously. When theattribute is set to(3),is ignored. When theattribute is set to(2),sets the time between phasor triggers and theis ignored.

attributes.name: intervalcycle
attributes.digest: Interval Deviation Cycle (2 - 16)
attributes.description: Sets the number of intervals after which the mean interval time (as specified by theattribute) is restored. The time interval used byis not necessarily the value of theattribute if theattribute is set to a non-zero value and creates variation in the intervals calculated. As an example, say theis set to 100 ms but the last interval (due to a non-zero) was 90. If theattribute is set to 2, the next interval used will be 110, in order that over the space of two intervals, the mean is maintained to be 100. If theattribute is set to 10, nine intervals will be generated before the tenth interval is adjusted to maintain the mean interval time. In the rare event that the prior intervals already exceed the mean interval time before the last interval of the cycle is calculated, the resulting correction interval will be 1 ms. In general, the larger the interval cycle the "wider" the interval variatons can be with larger values of.

attributes.description: Sets the proportion of the current value of theattribute that is allowed to vary randomly (above or below). Anvalue of 0 will produce no random variation in the interval.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Trigger Mode
attributes.description: Determines how new phasor ramps are triggered

choices.label: Maintains a proportion of the total available time and space (channels) with active phasor ramps, as set by theattribute. Theattribute sets the time between updates of the utilization and triggering of new phasors. As thebecomes larger, phasors will be triggered simtaneously to maintain the utilization level (more like a metronome). When the interval is small, the phasor triggering will be more distributed and it will be less likely that phasors will be triggered simultaeously.

Attempts to maintain a rate of new phasor triggerings (births) per unit time for each channel, as set by theattribute. However, if theattribute is to a time value that is slower than thethere may be more simultanous triggerings further apart.As an example, if theis 50 ms and theis 4, one phasor will be started roughly every 250 ms, becausewill check whether it's time to start a phasor every 50 ms. However, if theis 2000 ms, you'll hear as many as 20 phasors starting together every 2000 ms, becauseonly checks whether to start new phasors every 2000 ms. The effective rate of phasor starting at any momment may be further affected by the,,, andattributes.

Maintains a constant interval between phasor triggerings, as set by theandattributes. Theattribute determines the probability of a phasor being triggered at any particular interval. Theattribute has no effect in this mode.
Triggers new phasors when audio-channels sample values exceed the signal input threshold (set by theattribute). Theandattributes have no effect in this mode.

As theattribute value is increased, the average number of new ramps (births) per unit time will be lower.When theattribute is set to(1), the value ofreduces the average(the actual rate will be the value of themultiplied by the). For example if theis 0.5 and it is time to start a new phasor according to the, it will only happen half the time based on a random decision.When theattribute is set to(2), thedetermines whether a phasor is actually generated at the specified interval. If the value ofis 1.0, the phasor will always be generated. If the value ofis 0.5, the phasor will be generated half the time based on a random decision.When theattribute is set to(3),has no effect.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: When the Trigger Mode () attribute ofis set to(3), a new phasor ramp is started. If theattribute is set, the ramp occurs only on a non-busy output channel corresponding to any channel where a sample exceeds the current signal input threshold. If there are more input audio channels than output channels -- the output channel count is set by theattribute -- the additional input channels are ignored. Ifis 0, the next available (non-busy) output channel is used.In right inlet: A signal connected to the right inlet sets the ramp duration, overriding the value of theattribute. If a multi-channel signal is connected, the channel of the input corresponding to the channel of the output ramp is used for the duration.

inlets.description: When the Trigger Mode () attribute ofis set to(3), a new phasor ramp is started on an output channel corresponding to any channel where a sample value exceeds the current signal input threshold. If there are more input audio channels than output channels (set by theattribute), the additional input channels are ignored.

A signal connected to the right inlet sets the ramp duration, overriding the value of theattribute. If a multi-channel signal is connected, the channel of the input corresponding to the channel of the output ramp is used for the duration.

outlets.description: Audio signals consisting of 0 - 1 ramps triggered according to theobject's current settings.
